en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4960 - In the narration of Abdullah ibn Maymun from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), it is reported that Imam (as) said:

"The adulterer has six traits, three in this world and three in the Hereafter.
As for those in this world: his face loses its brightness, he inherits poverty, and his destruction is hastened.
As for those in the Hereafter: the wrath of the Lord (azj), a severe reckoning, and eternal residence in the Fire."
